description: SWEPOS- efterberäkningsdata is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) observation data from SWEPOS (Latvia's support system for satellite positioning in Sweden) network of fixed reference stations. Coverage: Lantmäteriet. The portal shows the English title as "SWEPOS post-calculation data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lantmäteriet. Its keywords include Geodatasamverkan. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 1994-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
